title: Lift an etale cover and its source comparisons across a thickening
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be any scheme morphism, $r:R\to Y$ a surjective closed immersion, and $U\subseteq Y$ open. Given an etale cover $(T_k\to r^{-1}U)_k$, there is an etale cover $(S_i\to U)_i$ and, for every $i$, an old index $k$ with surjective closed immersions $t:T_k\to S_i$ and $p:T_k\times_{r^{-1}U}(X\times_Y R)|_{r^{-1}U}\to S_i\times_U X|_U$. These satisfy $p\circ\mathrm{pr}_1=\mathrm{pr}_1\circ t$ in diagrammatic order, i.e. the new first projection after p equals t after the old first projection. No finiteness condition on f or nonemptiness assumption is needed.

proof.text: Restrict r to U. The restriction remains a surjective closed immersion; its surjectivity is checked by lifting a point of U to R. It is a universal homeomorphism. Essential surjectivity of etale base change gives an etale lift S_k of each T_k and an isomorphism S_k times_U U_R ≅ T_k over U_R.

Define t_k by the inverse of this isomorphism followed by the first pullback projection. It is a surjective closed immersion. Its composite with S_k -> U equals T_k -> U_R -> U. Given x in U, lift it to U_R and then to a member of the old cover; its image under t_k proves that the S_k cover U. This construction preserves the old index type, including an empty index type.

Restrict the defining pullback square of X times_Y R to the inverse images of U, using Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE. For each cover member define p by pullback.lift. Paste the old source pullback square with the restricted square, and cancel the new source pullback square with IsPullback.of_right. This proves p is a base change of t_k, hence a surjective closed immersion, and pullback.lift_fst gives the projection equation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_cover_thickening_lift
    {X Y R : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (r : R ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion r] [Surjective r] (U : Y.Opens)
    (𝒯 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage (r ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) :
    ∃ 𝒮 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage U.toScheme, ∀ i,
      ∃ (k : 𝒯.I₀) (t : 𝒯.X k ⟶ 𝒮.X i)
        (p : pullback (𝒯.f k) (pullback.snd f r ∣_ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ⟶
          pullback (𝒮.f i) (f ∣_ U)),
        IsClosedImmersion t ∧ Surjective t ∧
        IsClosedImmersion p ∧ Surjective p ∧
        p ≫ pullback.fst (𝒮.f i) (f ∣_ U) =
          pullback.fst (𝒯.f k) (pullback.snd f r ∣_ (r ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫ t
